source: SNSP / INEGI; García Harfuch security balance, H1 2026 report (early July 2026)
contestNote: H1 2026 (Jan–Jun): 8,988 homicides nationally, daily avg 49.7 — down 30.1% vs. same period 2025. Critics note: disappearances still rising; Sinaloa cartel conflict ongoing; independent analysts warn of potential reclassification effects.
delta: -30.1% YoY H1 2026 (49.7/day avg); June 2026 lowest June in 12 years (45.4/day)

label: GDP Growth (Q1 2026 / Q2 2026 / 2026 full-year forecast)
source: INEGI Q2 2026 preliminary (July 30); OECD Economic Outlook June 3, 2026; Citi Encuesta de Expectativas May 21, 2026
contestNote: Q1 2026: -0.8% QoQ, +0.2% annual (all sectors declined). Q2 2026 (July 30 release): +2.1% YoY, +1.5% QoQ seasonally adjusted — strongest quarterly rebound since Q4 2020, boosted by World Cup-related consumer/tourism spending; services +1.5% QoQ, industry +1.6% QoQ, primary sector +3.3% QoQ. Government says 1.5% full-year target still reachable absent an H2 contraction. Independent full-year 2026 forecasts remain more cautious: OECD 0.8% (most pessimistic), Citi 1.1%, IMF 1.6%, BBVA 1.8% — reflecting continued USMCA-review and tariff uncertainty.
